description: Keyword search over incident clusters (each cluster is one deduplicated story built from every source that covered it). Best for named things: actors, malware, vendors, products, CVE ids, companies, countries. Matching is literal: it tries the exact phrase, then all words together, then any word, and finally widens the time window if still under 3 hits; `matched_stage` says which stage matched. Use `alternatives` for spellings and synonyms (UK / United Kingdom / British). Costs 1 credit per term searched; at most 8 API calls per invocation, and `api_calls` in the result says how many were made. For one call that also covers entity profiles and the dark web use search_everything instead (5 credits).

alternatives.description: other names for the same thing, OR'd with query

days.description: only clusters with reporting in the last N days (free keys: up to 7)
